steps.caption: Open Capture after any call, meeting or site visit.
New capture: three ways in. Speak — words appear as you talk.
Photo — snap a visiting card or a whiteboard; the text is read from it.
Language: English, Hindi / Hinglish or Marathi — pick what you'll speak or write.
More options lets you set when it actually happened, if it wasn't just now.
Add files: upload documents such as a lease, LOI or floor plan.
Link to a record ties the file to a company, person, building, requirement, meeting, lease or transaction.
Recent captures lists earlier notes, with their status and how many changes they propose.
Now choose Type to write or paste a note.
Write what happened, in plain words.
Save it. Nothing in your records changes yet.
CRE OS read the note. The receipt lists what it saved, matched and scheduled.
'By March' is a target, not a contract date: the year stays unknown instead of being guessed.
'Friday' became a task due this Friday — no question needed.
This box lists exactly what will be added: a meeting log, requirement details and a task.
Each line shows the company or person it belongs to — check the names and numbers.
Looks right? Press Reviewed — now it goes to your records.
Facts for approval: important changes are listed with where they came from.
Each one can be checked and undone later from Review → History & undo.
The capture's status now reads Reviewed.
Open the company to see the result.
The Requirements tab shows the 25,000 sq ft need in Kharadi.
Timeline holds the meeting log from your note.
And the follow-up task is waiting in Today → Tasks.
Review in the sidebar is where any change still waiting for you shows up.
